$description: Statement-picker permutation coverage for workspace 55390: one delivered
service row per (board, participant, year 2022-2026, month 1-12) plus one
budget row per SaH participant x standard stream x month, so every Monthly
Statement Generator combination loads a populated statement — services,
summary, and all six Individualised Budgets streams. Amounts vary
Folder ids ARE folder names (see getFolderOffline): service rows live in
'Shift Planning and Reporting', profiles in '📋 Participants Intake',
budget rows in their stream folder — so the folder-filtered routes behave
like live ISO+. Composable with either 55390 fixture; ids are disjoint
(55390e00- prefix). No Timesheet Approval anywhere, so no invoice path can
ever bill these rows (they do share the invoice lists via the service
folder, like any live shift row would).
Years mirror the 2026 picker (currentYear-4 .. currentYear); regenerate

capturedFrom.via: synthesized from the monthly-statement picker matrix (5 years x 12 months x board participants)
